protocol.precision: FP32 master / BF16 autocast / SDPA math
protocol.question_order: paired per repetition, seeds101/102/103; rotate arm order across repeats
protocol.purpose: Dedicated uncontended update timing, separate from primary replication wall times affected by external GPU contention. Also report shape-based supported-operator FLOPs on one matched32-question batch; no claim of complete FLOPs.

note: Synchronized elapsed time includes batch construction, forward, backward, clipping and AdamW update. Three repetitions, each with five unreported warmup updates and twenty measured updates. Same question sequence across targets per repetition; target order rotates. No external GPU compute process at per-run boundary checks. CPU/host remain shared. FLOPs are shape-based estimates for operators supported by torch.profiler (for example mm, addmm, bmm), not a complete FLOP count or a hardware counter. One fixed32-question batch is profiled; that batch does not estimate average dataset FLOPs. Profiling updates are excluded from timing samples. No checkpoints are written or changed; all fits are discarded.
